assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq stranded mRNA, NextSeq 500 SE76), mouse liver
model: neonatal DMBA + high-fat diet steatosis-associated liver cancer, male C57BL/6 mice; treadmill 18 m/min, 20 min/day, 5 d/wk for last 10 of 35 weeks
sample_inclusion: HFD-fed DMBA mice, n=4 per exercise arm; non-tumor and tumor liver tissue from each mouse; ND non-exercise mice (n=4) are a diet reference with no exercise arm
primary_estimand: Effect of regular treadmill exercise vs non-exercise on liver gene expression in DMBA/HFD mice, within non-tumor and within tumor tissue
planned_contrasts: HFD exercise vs HFD non-exercise, non-tumor liver (abstract: exercise vs non-exercise liver profiles; no DEG count in abstract)
HFD exercise vs HFD non-exercise, tumor tissue (GEO summary: RNA from non-tumor and tumor tissues; no DEG count in abstract)
repeated_measure_unit: mouse (tumor and non-tumor from the same liver); irrelevant within a tissue stratum
paper_results: Per1 and Cry2 up in exercise; E2F1 and c-Myc target genes down; E2f1 and Myc mRNA unchanged
